package max_product_tuple_test

import (
	"testing"
	"fmt"
)

// Write a function to find the maximum absolute product between numbers in pairs of lists within a given list.
func max_product_tuple(list1 [][]interface{}) int {
	if len(list1) < 2 {
		return 0
	}

	var maxProduct int
	found := false

	for i := 0; i < len(list1); i++ {
		for j := i + 1; j < len(list1); j++ {
			for _, a := range list1[i] {
				for _, b := range list1[j] {
					// Try to convert both values to int
					var valA, valB int
					var okA, okB bool

					switch v := a.(type) {
					case int:
						valA = v
						okA = true
					case int64:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case float64:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case float32:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case uint:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case uint64:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case uint32:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case int32:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case int16:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case uint16:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case int8:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					case uint8:
						valA = int(v)
						okA = true
					default:
						okA = false
					}

					switch v := b.(type) {
					case int:
						valB = v
						okB = true
					case int64:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case float64:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case float32:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case uint:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case uint64:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case uint32:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case int32:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case int16:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case uint16:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case int8:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					case uint8:
						valB = int(v)
						okB = true
					default:
						okB = false
					}

					if okA && okB {
						product := valA * valB
						absProduct := product
						if absProduct < 0 {
							absProduct = -absProduct
						}
						if !found || absProduct > maxProduct {
							maxProduct = absProduct
							found = true
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if !found {
		return 0
	}
	return maxProduct
}

package sum_of_digits_test

import (
	"testing"
	"fmt"
)

// Write a function to compute the sum of digits of each number of a given list.
func sum_of_digits(nums []interface{}) int {
	total := 0
	for _, n := range nums {
		var val int
		switch v := n.(type) {
		case int:
			val = v
		case int8:
			val = int(v)
		case int16:
			val = int(v)
		case int32:
			val = int(v)
		case int64:
			val = int(v)
		case uint:
			val = int(v)
		case uint8:
			val = int(v)
		case uint16:
			val = int(v)
		case uint32:
			val = int(v)
		case uint64:
			val = int(v)
		case float32:
			val = int(v)
		case float64:
			val = int(v)
		default:
			fmt.Printf("Unsupported type: %T\n", n)
			continue
		}
		if val < 0 {
			val = -val
		}
		for val > 0 {
			total += val % 10
			val /= 10
		}
	}
	return total
}
